Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an arbitrary “two-source validation” that wrongly excluded Delmer Daves’s producer role despite Britannica’s listing (“American Screenwriter, Director & Film Producer”) and then applied an irrelevant tie-breaker based on number of directed films. “Scope of profession” should reflect breadth of distinct roles; Daves (screenwriter, director, producer) clearly exceeds Phil Rosen (director, cinematographer). This misinterpretation and factual oversight led to the incorrect final answer.
